source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Build ROCm/RVS and run `../bin/rvs -c conf/peqt_single.conf -d 3` against the AMD GPU specification.
procedure_facts: Uses unpinned documentation/repository links and a relative configuration path.
Machine time and attended time are each 10 minutes.
missing_source_information: GPU-specific PEQT configuration, pinned versions, PEQT expectations and platform specification.

original_test_intent.statement: Execute the RVS PCI Express Qualification Tool configuration for the target AMD GPU platform and verify every configured PCIe qualification result against the applicable specification.
must_preserve: PEQT module, exact source command/config name and debug level 3.
Ten-minute planned run and complete result/spec comparison.
must_not_infer: That `-d 3` selects a device or duration.
That generic PEQT defaults apply to the target GPU.
That RVS process success proves all actions passed.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 pins ROCm/RVS/config, preserves the exact command and requires workload monitoring, full output and per-result comparison.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 calls PEQT a generic full GPU workload but does not state its PCIe qualification purpose or clarify from official RVS documentation that `-d` is debugLevel, which can lead to wrong target/duration assumptions.

related_records: RVS GST or other module configurations do not define PEQT acceptance.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The named PEQT configuration controls scope; vendor documentation clarifies option/module semantics without supplying platform thresholds.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Run the pinned GPU-specific PEQT configuration as a PCIe qualification test; preserve debug level 3 as logging verbosity, prove device/link scope from the YAML and compare each action result to the platform recipe.

missing: Pinned ROCm/RVS, actual YAML, GPU/BDF/link coverage, expected results, workload/thermal guardrails and approval.
provider: AMD/platform owner supplies supported matrix, PEQT YAML and spec.
Lab owner approves build/load and recovery controls.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory RVS/ROCm/GPU/BDF/PCIe link versions/state, inspect but do not execute pinned config, and collect baseline logs/telemetry.
prohibited_until_resolved: Live clone/build, arbitrary config substitution, PEQT launch, firmware/link mutation or PASS.
closure_evidence: Pinned artifacts/YAML, parsed target/action coverage, approved expected results and guarded window.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run RVS PEQT PCIe Qualification Configuration
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved RVS PEQT YAML for the target AMD GPUs and verify every configured PCIe qualification action/result, link/device scope and system-health outcome against the platform specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact supported AMD GPU/server, ROCm/driver/firmware and RVS revision. Use the GPU-specific PEQT configuration when the approved RVS package provides one; generic defaults cannot replace the platform recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All GPU UUID/BDFs and PCIe links explicitly selected by `peqt_single.conf`; the configuration content defines whether `single` means one device, one action sequence or another scope. `-d 3` is debug logging level 3, not GPU 3 or a three-unit duration.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned signed/checksummed ROCm/RVS artifacts; supported compatibility matrix; reviewed `peqt_single.conf` with resolved includes/paths; target GPU/BDF/link map; per-action expected values; 10-minute execution/timeout interpretation; power/thermal/watchdog/abort limits; maintenance and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture baseline GPU/PCIe topology, link width/speed/status, versions, telemetry and logs. Verify artifact/config identity and parse the YAML to list module, actions, targets, durations and expected results. In the approved environment run exactly `../bin/rvs -c conf/peqt_single.conf -d 3` under the approved timeout/watchdog. Preserve complete structured/text output and correlate every PEQT action to the intended GPU/BDF/link, then compare each result and post-test link/system health to specification.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Pinned supported stack; reviewed configuration resolves correctly; intended targets and expectations proven; GPUs idle/healthy; sufficient cooling/power; OOB and abort controls ready; approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Artifact hashes and build/package manifest; ROCm/RVS/config versions; exact YAML and parsed action/target/expected matrix; GPU UUID/BDF and PCIe topology/link baseline; exact command/status/timing; debug-level-3 output; per-action result and specification comparison; telemetry; AER/RAS/kernel/BMC/SEL deltas; process exit and restored health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved AMD/platform PEQT recipe and specification for the exact GPU/server/RVS revision. Pass requires every configured action for every intended target to meet its declared result, the command/config to be exact, and no disqualifying PCIe/GPU/system error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not treat `-d 3` as a target/duration, use a moving repository, substitute GST or generic configs, omit YAML includes/targets, run on active GPUs, change firmware/link settings, auto-retry failures, or accept only the final process status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approves artifacts, YAML scope/expected values and platform matrix; lab approves guarded execution; engineer judges action failures and link/system logs.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent may validate/run/parse after authorization; configuration applicability and final anomaly judgment remain human responsibilities.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On config/build error, timeout, GPU reset, PEQT failure, AER/RAS, link degradation or thermal/power breach, stop RVS/children, preserve evidence, return devices to idle, verify topology/health and use approved driver/reboot/OOB escalation before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unpinned/incompatible stack; unresolved config/include; unknown target or expected result; absent approval/watchdog/recovery; unhealthy GPU/link; timeout/hang; PEQT false/error; reset/AER/RAS; thermal/power breach; incomplete per-action output.

identified_defects: PEQT's PCIe qualification role is unstated.
`-d 3` can be misread as device or duration.
Config-defined target/action scope is not exposed.
reason_for_change: Make the named RVS module and option semantics unambiguous so the agent validates the intended PCIe actions rather than running a generic GPU stress test.
